entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A studious young planeswalker from Eldraine and Rowan's twin brother, who wants to learn defensive magic against the Oriq.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A headstrong lightning-wielding planeswalker, Will's twin, who drifts toward Witherbloom friends and starts siphoning magic from elementals.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A violet-eyed professor at Strixhaven whose feared exams and hints about this plane suggest she is a planeswalker; she warns the twins about the Oriq.

entities.name: Quint
entities.description: Will's long-snouted, tea-loving friend who knows spells for digs and revels in history.

entities.name: Auvernine
entities.description: A Witherbloom witch and friend of Rowan who drains a saltgobbler to power a potion.

entities.name: Plink
entities.description: A Witherbloom friend of Rowan.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A woman with a staff and owls who watches the twins and Lukka through her birds and fights Lukka at the edge of campus.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker beast-bonder, former military leader, who works with Extus and the Oriq to bring down Strixhaven's mages.

entities.name: Mila
entities.description: Lukka's fox companion.

entities.name: Extus
entities.description: The leader of the Oriq who orders the attack on the school with mage hunters under Lukka's control.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A figure from the twins' past who threatened them and their father.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A masked society of mages that opposes Strixhaven and prepares an attack.

entities.name: Mage hunters
entities.description: Chitinous creatures with a purple glow that swarm toward the school under Lukka's control.

entities.name: Dragonsguard
entities.description: Dragon-trained mages whom Lukka accuses of making people fearful.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The blue and red college whose team plays in the Mage Tower match.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: The black and white college whose team plays Prismari in the Mage Tower match.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: The nature-mage college where Rowan's friends study.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university of mages where the twins study.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: The library where Will studies.

entities.name: Bow's End
entities.description: A campus cafe where Rowan meets her Witherbloom friends.

entities.name: Mage Tower
entities.description: A magical sport between college teams with a floating mascot, played before cheering stands.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The twins' home plane.

entities.name: Kylem
entities.description: The twins' previous home.

events.summary: Will and Rowan argue about her lack of study, and lightning sparks from her hair when she gets angry.
events.quote: it was the coils of electricity jumping between loose strands of hair on his sister's face

events.summary: Quint spills tea on ancient books and fixes it with a like-to-like spell.
events.quote: The spilled tea began to rise, small droplets floating from the page to fall back into Quint's cup.

events.summary: Will confronts Rowan at Bow's End about barely passing Professor Onyx's exam.
events.quote: You barely passed, Rowan

events.summary: Will invokes their birth mother, and Rowan's anger crackles through the air.
events.quote: Will could feel the hair on his arms stand up as an electric charge coursed through the air around him.

events.summary: Rowan leaves with her Witherbloom friends, telling Will to leave her alone.
events.quote: Leave me alone, Will. You can't tell me what to do.

events.summary: The twins stop speaking for weeks until the Mage Tower match.
events.quote: he hadn't spoken to her in weeks

events.summary: A Prismari player hypnotizes the Silverquill mascot into biting its holder and steals it in the Mage Tower match.
events.quote: Suddenly, it leaned over and sunk two long liquid fangs into the Silverquill player's hand.

events.summary: Will provokes Rowan in the stands, and she shocks him with lightning.
events.quote: Will felt the spark jump from her outstretched hand and pass through his whole body in an instant.

events.summary: Will freezes Rowan's boots and hand with his ice magic.
events.quote: Rowan gasped as a rime of frost suddenly solidified around her boots, freezing her feet in place.

events.summary: Professor Onyx stops the fight and takes the twins to her office.
events.quote: He squinted as he looked up, meeting Professor Onyx's gaze.

events.summary: Professor Onyx warns the twins about the Oriq and hints Strixhaven does not hold all power on the plane, leaving Will suspecting she is a planeswalker.
events.quote: Strixhaven doesn't have a monopoly on power in this plane.

events.summary: Will wants to prepare to defend the students, while Rowan says she will prepare her own way.
events.quote: I'll prepare my own way for whatever's coming.

events.summary: Kasmina watches Rowan practice lightning through her owl.
events.quote: Below, she could see the Kenrith girl sending forked lightning across the lawn.

events.summary: Kasmina's owl sees a masked Oriq agent offer Lukka a silver skull mask, which he refuses.
events.quote: It was a silver mask, shaped like a human skull.

events.summary: Auvernine siphons the life force of a saltgobbler into a potion.
events.quote: Rowan's hand went to her mouth as she watched the creature's life force flow through the air and into her friend's potion.

events.summary: Rowan siphons power from a water elemental in the Biblioplex.
events.quote: Electricity crackled and leapt across her fingers as she pulled the veins of power out of its watery surface, toward her.

events.summary: Rowan tells Will she has learned that breaking the rules gets things done and leaves him.
events.quote: I learned that when you're not afraid to break the rules, you can get a whole lot done.

events.summary: Kasmina confronts Lukka at the edge of the courtyard and he refuses to be anyone's pawn.
events.quote: It's a shame to see a man like you fallen so far.

events.summary: Kasmina and Lukka fight with wind and blade.
events.quote: Kasmina sent a scythe of pressurized air straight at Lukka's chest.

events.summary: Kasmina warns Lukka that Extus fights only for himself.
events.quote: Do you think Extus is going to change all that?

events.summary: Kasmina pins Lukka with her staff and demands he yield.
events.quote: Before he could get up, Kasmina was there, the point of her staff held just under his chin.

events.summary: A swarm of mage hunters approaches the school, and Lukka says they are just getting started.
events.quote: a swarm of chitinous, chittering forms scurried between the trees

events.summary: Kasmina flees in a cloud of white feathers.
events.quote: a cloud of white feathers whipped over her, and she was gone

events.summary: Extus orders the Oriq to attack as Lukka controls the mage hunters.
events.quote: Commence the attack.

relations.quote: Just two siblings blowing off steam.
Quint grabbed Will and wrapped him in a hug as they both cheered with the rest of the crowd.

relations.note: She fights him to stop his path.
relations.quote: I'm not going to let you do that, Lukka.

relations.note: Lukka works with the Oriq leader.
relations.quote: I'm not like your other mages.
The agents stood ready, waiting for Extus's command.
